_doc: Copie machine des prompts de Miarritze Blackout. Ce qui fait foi : GDD-BLACKOUT.md (§8.2 pour les persos, §9 style, §14 pipeline) ; toute modification se fait d'abord dans le GDD, puis ici. Analyse du style : docs/STYLE_PARTY_HARD.md. Prompts en anglais, simples, sans négation, sans citer de jeu existant. Persos (v2) : prompt du moteur A = persos[id].description + '.' quand elle porte « clearly visible », sinon description + ', with ' + signature + ' clearly visible.' (23/10, GDD §8.2) ; rejeu : tools/blackout/party_hard_v2.py. Les gabarits (prop, cachette, sol, mur, anime, carte_zone) et style_commun servent au décor ; gabarits.perso et animations.* (48 px, pf_pro__character / pf_anim__*) sont l'essai du 21/10, remplacé par les moteurs A et B.

echelle._doc: Résolution native du monde et correspondance avec le jeu (rules.json tile_px = 64 en 1280×720).

palette._doc: Teintes de base relevées sur les captures (docs/STYLE_PARTY_HARD.md §2), transposées au soir de fête basque. Les grandes surfaces restent sombres et peu contrastées ; la couleur franche est réservée aux persos, aux lumières et aux cachettes.

style_commun.base: Pixel art game asset with crisp hard square pixels and a small limited palette. Top-down three-quarter cutaway view like a dollhouse with the roof lifted off: the ground seen from above, walls and objects showing their top and their front face, orthographic straight grid, every object square to the viewer. Setting: a summer evening festival in Biarritz in the French Basque Country at dusk, dark muted blue-violet base colors with saturated accents of Basque red, green and white, warm glowing lanterns and string lights. Each shape is edged with a darker shade of its own color, flat shading with one shadow tone and one highlight tone, light from above, cheerful and friendly mood for children.

par_type.perso: Single full-body character centered on a plain solid white background, feet on the bottom third line, readable silhouette at tiny size.
par_type.anim: Same character, same colors and same proportions in every frame, feet on the same ground line, evenly spaced frames on a plain solid white background.
par_type.prop: Single isolated object centered on a plain solid white background, the whole object inside the frame.
par_type.sol: Seamless tileable floor texture seen straight from above, filling the whole square edge to edge, low contrast, subtle pattern on an 8 pixel grid.
par_type.mur: Modular wall piece on a plain solid white background: a dark wall top strip seen from above and the wall front face below it.
par_type.carte: Whole area visible at once, seen from above with the roof lifted off, rooms outlined by thick dark wall tops, each room with its own floor pattern, dense furniture along the walls, open walkways two tiles wide.

perso.prompt: Tiny party game character, {gabarit_corps}, strict side view facing right, standing relaxed, {description}, with {signature} clearly visible. Hair as a simple block, face as a few skin pixels with one dark eye dot, bright shoes.

gabarits_corps.enfant: child proportions about four heads tall, 28 pixels tall, one-pixel arms and legs, slightly bigger head
gabarits_corps.adulte: slim proportions about five heads tall, 32 pixels tall, one-pixel arms and legs
gabarits_corps.costaud: broad sturdy proportions about five heads tall, 33 pixels tall, thick arms two pixels wide
gabarits_corps.creature: chunky round mascot proportions, 28 pixels tall, big head and big expressive eyes

anim._doc: Une anim = le perso décrit + l'action de animations[id] ; référence : l'image retenue du profil.

prop.prompt: {objet}, {taille_lisible}, seen from above at a three-quarter angle showing the top and the front face, aligned straight to the grid, muted evening colors with one warm light accent.

cachette.prompt: {objet}, a hiding spot big enough for a child to curl up inside, slightly bigger than the props around it, a bright orange #ff8a1c detail as its marker ({repere_orange}), seen from above at a three-quarter angle showing the top and the front face, aligned straight to the grid.

mur.prompt: {mur}, the top strip 6 pixels thick in near black #1b1e1f, the front face 24 pixels tall with {detail_facade}.

anime._doc: Objet animé du décor : générer l'image fixe avec prop, puis 4 images de boucle (pf_anim__keyframes ou retouche image par image).

carte_zone._doc: Maquette d'ambiance d'UNE zone (≈ 12 × 7 cases = 384 × 216 px natifs, taille max de pixelforge). Sert de référence de couleurs et de densité ; la carte jouable reste assemblée par le code à partir des sols, murs et objets.

sortie.prompt: {objet}, an exit marker glowing with a soft green lantern light, seen from above at a three-quarter angle showing the top and the front face.

musique._doc: Prompts de style musical (ex. Suno) : descriptifs, en anglais, sans nom d'artiste ni de jeu. Assemblage : base + ' ' + morceaux[id]. Analyse : docs/STYLE_PARTY_HARD.md §11 ; mode d'emploi : docs/PROMPTS_MUSIQUE.md. Mesures sur les bandes-annonces Steam : PH1 120 BPM, grosse caisse sur chaque temps, ~50 % de l'énergie sous 150 Hz ; PH2 120 BPM, motifs en croches plus funk.
musique.base: Upbeat retro electronic dance music for a cheerful children's party game, analog synth bass, bright arpeggiated synths, punchy drum machine, catchy hook, instrumental, playful and fun, family friendly, light Basque folk color.
touches_basques: txalaparta wooden plank percussion playing interlocking rhythms
irrintzi-like joyful high call as a short sample

menu.prompt: Warm synthwave groove at 110 BPM, mellow analog pads, gentle arpeggio, a trikitixa accordion melody answering the lead synth, relaxed sunset mood by the ocean, loopable.

chasse.prompt: Bouncy French-house style party track at 124 BPM, four-on-the-floor kick, offbeat open hi-hats, filtered disco chords, funky slap synth bass, pandero jingles, a trikitixa accordion hook in the chorus, builds every 16 bars, loopable.

chasse_fin.prompt: Urgent but fun electro finale at 132 BPM, rising synth riser, rapid txalaparta rolls, driving octave bass, cheerful tension, ends on a bright accent.

victoire_chasses.prompt: Short triumphant festive jingle, bright brass synth stab, trikitixa flourish, pandero shake, happy ending chord.

victoire_chasseur.prompt: Short cheeky victory jingle, bouncy synth bass, playful whistle-like txistu run, cartoon sparkle, happy ending chord.

trouve.prompt: Funny short surprise sting, cartoon boing, synth pluck going up, a quick pandero shake.
